'''2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner received a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 4 March 2000<ref name="tr-d314" />
* '''Site:''' Merritt Island, Florida; Kinder-Islander Comics, Merritt Island, Florida<ref name="tr-d320" />
* '''Players:''' 42<ref name="tr-d320" />

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam Charlie Herren beating of a lifetime]] ([[Charlie Herren]], [[Light]]; 1st) — "This is the deck I used to win the Florida Grand Slam"; he lists later swaps, so the posted list may differ
* [[2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam Mike Fitzgerald The Fragile]] ([[Mike Fitzgerald]], [[Light]]) — "This is the LS Deck I used at theFlorida Grand Slam"; no result given
* [[2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam Gabriel Alonso M&T Throne Room Start w/ Nudj (Non-Revo)]] ([[Gabriel Alonso]], [[Light]]; 3–0) — "This is the deck I used at the Florida Grand Slam. It went 3-0"
* [[2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam Gabriel Alonso Hunt Down with Focus on Dueling V 1]] ([[Gabriel Alonso]], [[Dark]]) — "This is the deck I played at the Florida Grand Slam"; no result given
